question_text: A group of activists alleges that they were unlawfully detained and tortured by police officers during a protest. They file a complaint with the Commission on Human Rights (CHR). Which of the following best describes the investigatory powers of the CHR in this situation?

options.text: It can conduct a full criminal investigation and file charges directly in court.
It can investigate the allegations, issue subpoenas, and recommend prosecution to the Ombudsman or other agencies.
It can order the arrest of the police officers involved.
It can only receive the complaint but has no power to investigate.
